subject.title: When calling a VLLM model, the usage page statistics show no data. How can I calculate usage and cost when using VLLM?

question: After reporter evidence is collected, should vLLM cost gaps be handled as local pricing documentation, an unknown-cost warning contract, or a runtime/UI aggregation bug?
rationale: The source path for vLLM token usage already exists, and the missing data determines whether this is a product contract around local pricing or a concrete code defect.

options.title: Collect evidence first
options.body: Keep this issue open until a raw vLLM stream, transcript row, Usage RPC responses, screenshot, and pricing config show the failing boundary.

options.title: Fold cost-only behavior into the pricing issue
options.body: If evidence shows tokens are present and only cost is missing or zero, preserve the vLLM context and route the remaining decision to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674.

options.title: Define a vLLM-specific pricing path
options.body: If maintainers want self-hosted vLLM costs to be first-class, require explicit docs or product behavior for configuring nonzero local pricing.

recommendation.title: Collect evidence first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a raw vLLM stream, transcript row, Usage RPC responses, screenshot, and pricing config show the failing boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Most of the relevant streaming usage and usage-cost pricing contract history points to steipete-authored commits.
